messages:
james_sales: Quick context — Tidewater Insurance (mid-market, $18k ARR). Signed yesterday. Primary ask: private deployment in us-west, SSO (Okta), and tokenized PII redaction for claims data. Go-live target: 2026-04-15. Known blockers: legal asked for KMS integration, security wants audit logs, and engineering may need a sample payload. I can share contract + SOC attachments.

elaine_cs: Thanks James — assigning a CSM. Sophia will take lead on activation and run the kickoff. Can you drop the Okta metadata and a sample payload (sanitized) here? Also tag the security rep so we can align on KMS SLA.

sophia_csm: Hi team — I’m on it. Next steps from CS side: 1) intro call with Tidewater + security & infra (this week) 2) collect sanitized payloads and Okta config 3) create onboarding playbook + enablement session for their infra team. Owners: sophia_csm (kickoff), mike_support (infra questions), elaine_cs (renewal health).

james_sales: Adding contacts: sara.t@tidewater.com (IT lead), raj.p@tidewater.com (Sec). Contract link: https://drive.redwood/tidewater/contract_v3.pdf. Sample payload (sanitized) attached here.

mike_support: Looping in infra checklist items: we need the VPC peering CIDR, estimate of peak RPS, and whether they want dedicated capacity or private (VPC). Also confirm KMS provider (AWS KMS or customer HSM). If they want e2e audit logs forwarded, we’ll setup the syslog endpoint.

sophia_csm: Thanks — can someone from sales confirm expected QPS? I’ll draft the kickoff agenda and post a calendar invite. Also suggesting this initial run use dedicated capacity with burst, then evaluate cost after first month.

james_sales: Expected steady-state ~120 QPS, spikes to ~400 for batch claim ingests (daily). They want cost predictability -> leaning dedicated. :thumbsup:

mike_support: Noted. I’ll open a support ticket for private deployment prep and KMS integration. Please include sample payload and Okta metadata in the ticket. Ticket draft: ``Ticket: TIDE-ONB-001
Owner: mike_support
Items: VPC/CIDR, peak RPS, Okta metadata, KMS provider, syslog URL``

elaine_cs: Perfect — Sophia, create the onboarding playbook in our template and include a short enablement checklist for their infra team. Also capture a renewal health note: committed ARR and any upsell opportunities (fraud detection add-on). Mark renewal risk low but monitor after first-month usage.

sophia_csm: Will do. I’ll run the kickoff tomorrow at 3pm PT and invite James, Sara, Raj, Mike. After the call I’ll post the action items and owners here.

james_sales: Scheduling now. Thanks everyone — I’ll send Sara/Raj the invite and add the legal attachments. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Deploy bot notice — created ticket TIDE-ONB-001 assigned to mike_support.
